testsuite.name: AetherSync Distributed Real-Time Collaboration & State Sync Engine
testsuite.author: QA Automation & Systems Team

testcase.name: RGA Sequential Character Insertion
testcase.objective: Verify characters inserted sequentially by a single replica produce exact visual string.

steps.step: Call rga.insert(0, 'H')
Call rga.insert(1, 'e')
Call rga.insert(2, 'l')
Call rga.insert(3, 'l')
Call rga.insert(4, 'o')

testcase.expected_results: rga.toString() returns exactly 'Hello'. Total active nodes = 5.

testcase.name: Concurrent RGA Insertions at Identical Cursor Index
testcase.objective: Verify that two replicas inserting characters at the exact same index deterministically converge.
testcase.preconditions: Both replicas Alice and Bob share initial state 'AB'.

steps.step: Alice inserts 'X' at visual index 1 (between A and B).
Bob concurrently inserts 'Y' at visual index 1 (between A and B).
Alice applies Bob's remote insert operation.
Bob applies Alice's remote insert operation.

testcase.expected_results: Both replicas converge to the exact same string (e.g., 'AYXB'). No character is lost, duplicated, or corrupted.

testcase.name: Concurrent Deletion and Insertion with Tombstones
testcase.objective: Verify concurrent edit and delete operations do not delete the wrong character.
testcase.preconditions: Replicas A and B have shared text 'CAT'.

steps.step: Replica A deletes character at index 1 ('A') -> creates tombstone.
Replica B concurrently inserts 'H' at index 2 (after 'A').
Cross-apply operations across replicas.

testcase.expected_results: Both replicas converge to 'CHT'. The newly inserted 'H' is preserved, while 'A' remains tombstoned.

testcase.name: LWW-Map Concurrent Canvas Item Mutations
testcase.objective: Verify Last-Write-Wins Map resolves simultaneous updates using Lamport timestamps.

steps.step: Site A updates card position: { x: 100, y: 200, color: 'blue' }.
Site B concurrently updates same card: { x: 150, y: 250, color: 'emerald' }.
Cross-apply ops between Site A and Site B.

testcase.expected_results: Higher Lamport timestamp wins deterministically across both sites. Object attributes converge to identical JSON values.

testcase.name: Out-of-Order Operation Idempotency
testcase.objective: Verify duplicate or out-of-order operations do not corrupt document state.

steps.step: Apply remote operation OP-1.
Apply remote operation OP-1 a second time (duplicate delivery).

testcase.expected_results: RgaSequence detects existing ID in nodeMap, ignores duplicate, returns false. Document remains clean and uncorrupted.

testcase.name: Optimistic Local Update Latency (0ms Perceived Lag)
testcase.objective: Verify user actions render in UI immediately without waiting for server network response.

steps.step: User types character into code editor.
Measure time between keydown and DOM render.

testcase.expected_results: Perceived UI render latency < 5ms. Mutation assigned monotonic opId and queued in pendingMutationQueue.

testcase.name: Offline Mutation Queue Accumulation During Socket Dropout
testcase.objective: Verify edits accumulate in memory and localStorage when connection is severed.

steps.step: Click 'Sever Socket Connection' in Chaos Lab.
Verify status pill changes to 'OFFLINE (0 QUEUED)'.
Type 5 characters in the editor.

testcase.expected_results: Status pill updates to 'OFFLINE (5 QUEUED)'. Queue inspector displays 5 unacknowledged mutations with timestamps.

testcase.name: Exponential Backoff Reconnect with Jitter
testcase.objective: Verify reconnection attempts back off exponentially to avoid thundering herd.

steps.step: Trigger unexpected socket disconnect.
Record timestamps of reconnection attempts #1, #2, #3, #4.

testcase.expected_results: Delays scale geometrically: baseDelay * 1.5^attempt + jitter. No runaway tight loops or infinite socket spam.

testcase.name: Reconnection Batch Catch-up and Queue Reconciliation
testcase.objective: Verify all queued mutations flush and reconcile upon reconnection without data loss.
testcase.preconditions: Client offline with 5 pending mutations in queue.

steps.step: Click 'Reconnect & Flush Queue'.
Client opens WebSocket and dispatches 'offline_catchup' batch payload.
Server applies all mutations and returns 'batch_ack'.

testcase.expected_results: pendingMutationQueue counter decrements to 0. All peer clients receive flushed mutations and converge.

testcase.name: Artificial Latency Injection Tolerance
testcase.objective: Verify system functions smoothly under severe high-latency conditions.
testcase.preconditions: Chaos simulator latency slider set to 1000ms.

steps.step: Type text in Window A.
Observe delayed propagation to Window B.

testcase.expected_results: Window A remains snappy (0ms). Window B integrates changes after 1000ms delay without cursor jumps or lost characters.

testcase.name: Simulated Packet Loss Recovery
testcase.objective: Verify state convergence under simulated 30% packet drop rate.
testcase.preconditions: Chaos simulator packet loss set to 30%.

steps.step: Perform concurrent edits across two windows.
Allow background retries and ACKs to resolve dropped frames.

testcase.expected_results: Checksums on both windows match once all frames settle.

testcase.name: Cross-Node WebSocket Synchronization
testcase.objective: Verify mutations from Node 1 (port 4001) propagate to Node 2 (port 4002) via Event Bus.
testcase.preconditions: Client 1 connected to Node 1. Client 2 connected to Node 2.

steps.step: Client 1 sends RGA mutation over ws://localhost:4001.
Node 1 publishes mutation to Event Bus channel 'collab:room:general'.
Node 2 receives event from bus and forwards to Client 2 over ws://localhost:4002.

testcase.expected_results: Client 2 receives mutation within 50ms. Both clients reflect the exact same document state.

testcase.name: Event Bus Fallback to Embedded Cluster Bus
testcase.objective: Verify system gracefully falls back to local cluster bus when external Redis is absent.
testcase.preconditions: Redis daemon not running on localhost:6379.

steps.step: Boot cluster via cluster.js.
Inspect server initialization logs.

testcase.expected_results: Logs indicate: 'Redis not detected. Using Embedded Cluster Bus.' Both nodes start cleanly with zero fatal crashes and full cross-node synchronization.

testcase.name: Live Client Node Migration / Failover
testcase.objective: Verify client can switch connected server nodes mid-session without data loss.

steps.step: Select 'Node 2 (Port 4002)' from dropdown.
Click 'Switch Node'.

testcase.expected_results: WebSocket disconnects from port 4001 and reconnects to port 4002. Fresh room snapshot is received and reconciled. Editor and Canvas retain full state.

testcase.name: Multi-Window Strong Eventual Consistency CRC Match
testcase.objective: Verify CRC checksum matches identically across multiple independent client replicas.
testcase.preconditions: Two browser sessions active on Node 1 and Node 2.

steps.step: Perform concurrent text edits and canvas card drags in both windows.
Stop editing and wait 500ms for network quiescence.
Compare CRC checksum values in the top header bar of both windows.

testcase.expected_results: Both windows display the exact identical CRC checksum (e.g., #3d8a4f91). Visual text and canvas card coordinates are byte-identical.
